headline: Ownership Shifts Along Restless Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, Nevish Line has swung from three Warden-held bases and five Colonial to seven Colonial and one neutral; its event ledger remains busy, with five rows in the latest two hours and 24 in six. Mooring County has also shifted, from 11 Warden bases and one Colonial to 10 and two, though no ownership events were logged in the latest two hours. Callahan’s Passage is now entirely Warden-held, its former neutral base restored to that count; five event rows appeared in six hours, but none in the last two. Linn’s Mercy holds steady at 10 Colonial bases and one neutral, with five recent event rows and 42 across the day. Weathered Expanse remains at seven Warden and two neutral, while its busy 24-hour record has gone quiet over the latest six hours. Marban Hollow’s four Warden, three Colonial and one neutral bases are unchanged, with no recent event rows. The war remains undecided; 34 victory towns are required.
